thought.text: The response stayed on the login page. Let me check for an error message and test the negative case (wrong password) to compare behavior.

reasoning_content:
The login POST returned the login page again (200, not 302). This could mean one of the following:
1. The login failed (invalid password?)
2. I missed a form field (e.g., ReturnLocation), or there's an error message displayed

Let me check the error message in the response HTML, and also try with an intentionally wrong password to compare the behavior. I'll take a look at login-after.html.

action.command: cd /tmp && grep -oiE '(falsch|fehler|error|ungültig|invalid|wrong|nicht|failed|unauthorized)[^<]{0,80}' login-after.html | head -10; echo '---form-diff---'; diff <(grep -oE '(name|value)="[^"]*"' qisutu-index.html | sort) <(grep -oE '(name|value)="[^"]*"' login-after.html | sort) | head -30
